summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed in the US via Form 6-K, furnished its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO interim certifications dated November 12, 2026, all incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 shelf registration. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory term is disclosed; this is routine periodic financial reporting equivalent to a US quarterly report. Risk-arb angle: none — watch only balance-sheet items such as the cash position and deferred acquisition costs.
